message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦４

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, how'd it go!? Did you get him to m-m-m-massage them?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell I could do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aww. So Operation Do-or-Die Grope was a bust too, huh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Geez, if it's come to this, I'll make a move on Synn-kun myself! And then you can use me as an example, Nana-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-N-No, not that! Definitely not that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine. It's not like I have the hots for Synn-kun anyway, so I won't get serious about him. Probably」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But what if Synn... what if... maybe...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh boy. You've got it really bad, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, Sacchin! Even I figured that just waiting around all the time isn't gonna cut it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh. Did you come up with something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a villain's laugh. You're plotting something, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am a maiden in love myself, after all, so I've already made the proper preparations」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat!? Since when?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh heh heh. The day after tomorrow is--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, it's Synn-kun's birthday, isn't it. Which means----」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've already got his present ready! And of course, my research was spot-on」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now that's nice. Synn-kun's gonna fall head over heels with that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's more, none of my potential rivals should have presents prepared!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat. Aiming to steal a march on them, huh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're being a little devious, Nana-chan! Still, you're a maiden in love, after all. Go for it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, I'll do my best!」
